page.content:
Cartoonist who created Pepe in the comic Boy's Club.

How Matt Furie connects

  • Work: Pepe the Frog — Matt Furie created Pepe the Frog in Boy's Club.
  • Work: Pepe the Frog — Furie later tried to reclaim or retire Pepe after political reuse he did not authorize.

What is Matt Furie?

Matt Furie drew Pepe as a stoner roommate, then spent years trying to reclaim or kill the character after far-right reuse — a documented authorship fight over a meme.

Key threads lead to Pepe the Frog and Pepe the Frog.
